description: This Java source file defines the DelegatorContainer class, which implements the Container interface. It manages the initialization and startup of delegator components within the OFBiz framework, specifically handling preloaded delegator names and starting their associated delegates asynchronously.

classes.name: DelegatorContainer
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of delegator components in the OFBiz framework, handling initialization with configuration data and starting delegators asynchronously.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with commands, name, and configuration file, setting up preloaded delegator names based on configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts all preloaded delegators asynchronously if any are configured.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the container; currently no implementation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of this container instance.
